no initial
initial is not a state

a state id with a space, a state that is a string, a nested states, a title that is not a string; with errors, reachability is not reported

a transition without from, one whose to is not a state, one carrying event
a guard that is a number, a schema outside the subset, a guard reading a variable not in vars

a reference guard into a document that is not there

a variable name with a dot, a variable that is a string, a variable without default

current= is a state
a state nobody reaches is a warning; the chart still loads
a self-loop and a repeated pair are allowed; an anyOf guard is read through every branch
an anyOf branch reading an undeclared variable
a single state and no transition: valid, and the state is final
a document without a statechart block has nothing to check
a final state with a way out is an error
a state with no way out that is not marked final is a warning; the chart still loads
final that is not a boolean
a guard reads the variables its top level and its anyOf / oneOf branches name; properties under a variable describe that variable's value, not more variables
a variable whose name is not a NAME is not in vars, so a guard reading it is reported as well
with vars not an object, a guard or a reset naming a variable is not reported again
a self-loop is a way out: a state whose only transition returns to it is no dead end
an error anywhere in the chart holds back its warnings: an unreachable dead end beside a variable without default
a final state with a way out is reported beside other errors
a reference guard to a block that is not a data block
a string with a space, or naming a document that is not .geml, is a sentence guard, not a reference
every problem of one transition is its own error
every name a reset gets wrong is its own error, and a reset that is not an array of names is one
the subset's own shapes: oneOf with one branch, a const that does not fit type, an empty enum, a type that is not one name
reserved and mistyped keys of a state, and a guard that is null; a statechart's own top-level key and an action the format does not know are fine
data= names a data block in another document
an empty body and no data= is not a definition
